name: smwmusic-space-harrier-heroes-take-flight-main-theme-remix
title: Space Harrier - Heroes Take Flight!! ~ Main Theme (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of the Space Harrier theme. Ended up playing the arcade version of this game in the SEGA arcade found in Yakuza 0 and fell in love with this theme. I really wanted to do a much more fast-paced, action-like version of this song, since it'd be very fitting for flight stages.

This baby is great for title screens, credits, athletic / sky stages, and skypop stages.

Important:
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
